text: じぶんに　きけんが　せまると　まるくなって　みを　まもる。

structure.jp: じぶんに　きけんが　せまると
structure.en: when danger closes in on it
it curls into a ball and

patterns.name: 〜と (when)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain verb means 'when' or 'whenever', with a result that always follows. きけんが　せまると = 'whenever danger closes in'.

patterns.name: 〜くなる
patterns.explanation: A describing word with its い changed to く plus なる means 'become that way'. まるくなって = 'becoming round'.

patterns.name: 〜て (how)
patterns.explanation: The て-form here tells how the next action is done, like 'by doing'. まるくなって　みを　まもる = 'protects itself by curling up'.
